function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate, using only evidence available through October 1, 2026 and preserving the exact source IDs returned by your tools, the chronology of the MOVEit Transfer mass-exploitation campaign from disclosure of the relevant vulnerability (including the CVE identifier and disclosure timeline), through exploitation and initial victim/technology scope, deployment and technical characteristics of the LEMURLOOT web shell or malware, public attribution claims involving FIN11 and CL0P, and any documented connections between the campaign and CL0P-linked extortion infrastructure. Extract exact dates, affected technologies and entities, exploit and malware relationships, attribution wording, infrastructure indicators or relationships, and source provenance. Clearly label directly observed or documented facts versus vendor/government allegations, analytic assessments, and uncertainty. Identify gaps, discrepancies, or conflicts among sources.
